issue.title: Work Log entries on the =x Pomodoro close
issue.description: `bob capture '=x2,3 2 wired the lexer'` closes the running Pomodoro with tasks 2 and 3 in progress and first adds `wired the lexer` as a sub-bullet under Task Link 2, so the unchanged close writes it to that task's Work Log. Bob Mac Capture highlights, previews, and submits the same drafts, and every mistake is caught loudly before anything is written.
